name: Rampardos ex
author: hncl

abilities.name: Destructive Headbutting
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may use this Ability. Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent’s Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Rowdy Hammer
attacks.effect: During your next turn, attacks used by this Pokémon do 150 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

rule_box: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
